beats.text: In Belarus, 65.7% of youth are neither working nor in school. In Japan, 3.1%.
That gives Belarus the world's highest share of disengaged young people.
Japan holds the world's lowest share, keeping nearly everyone learning or earning.
India has 25.6% of young people aged 15 to 24 neither working nor in school.
USA has 11.6%, while Germany drops to 8.2%.
Norway has 6.2%, Sweden has 5.0%, and Netherlands has 3.9%.
